rows.requirement: Source-missing endpoint models are retained for history and can be explicitly cleaned only after the 30-day source gate, no recent production use, and the all-Food-reference guard pass.
runtime_scenarios: Replay an obsolete model with recent production use and an inactive Food reference; both remain protected.
Replay an unreferenced source-missing model older than 30 days; explicit cleanup removes only that model.
platform_conditions: CPython 3.9.25 and isolated Provider/report/Food data roots
evidence: artifact: source-missing models remain retained for recent production use and are deleted only after the stale-source gate passes
review: explicit cleanup rechecks source age, production evidence, and every Food reference before mutation

rows.requirement: Finished raw observations are rolled into content-free daily aggregates exactly once, survive repository restart, and merge late observations without losing counts, boundaries, or latency statistics.
runtime_scenarios: Compact old finished observations, recreate the repository, append a late observation to the same daily bucket, and compact again.
Leave a running run untouched while finished old runs are compacted.
evidence: artifact: daily rollups merge counts, boundaries, and latency after repository restart while running observations remain raw
review: retention is the only deletion path and rollup updates are performed under one SQLite write transaction

rows.requirement: Every registered product operation is server-gated by the same lifecycle/model projection: Core operations require Core, world operations require World, chat requires an executable Common route, and adoption requires World plus READY Common/Emergency model service.
runtime_scenarios: Project persisted Common/Emergency Food evidence and issue permits without startup inference.
Reject chat/adoption at the server boundary when their required model route is unavailable.
platform_conditions: CPython 3.9.25 and isolated persisted model evidence
evidence: artifact: persisted Common/Emergency evidence projects to READY and binds permits to the lifecycle/model revisions
review: Core/World/Chat/Adoption operations are server-gated by the single capability registry; no startup inference is introduced
